title: wissadula wissadifolia
intro: Wissadula wissadifolia, commonly known as West Indian Jasmine or Night-scented Jasmine, is a flowering plant species in the family Malvaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as reducing anxiety and stress due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Wissadula wissadifolia include acting as a sedative and anxiolytic, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its therapeutic potential and bioactive constituents.
